items.rationale: Cost of establishing cause and extent under 5.2.6(b), well within the EUR 3,000 cap; uses the prior rate of about 524 per flat rate.
Leak location under 5.2.6(a), which shares the EUR 1,000 cap with technician time (line 3). Case 20 shows this flat rate at 707 or more, and the combined total with line 3 stays under the cap.
Technician on-site time for leak location is covered under 5.2.6(a) within the shared EUR 1,000 cap. 2.5 hrs at about 80/hr gives roughly 200, and the cap is not exceeded together with line 2.
One travel/vehicle charge per contractor per invoice under 5.2.6(c), capped at EUR 70 net (about 83 gross); prior about 79.

items.description: Repair of actively leaking copper joints
items.rationale: Under 2.4.3, porosity or ageing leakage counts as fracture damage for the sections shown to be leaking. Two weeping joints were sealed/renewed, priced at a typical flat repair rate.

items.description: Precautionary replacement of non-leaking copper run
items.rationale: 2.4.3 excludes sections not themselves shown to be leaking, and 7.1.5/7.1.8(a) exclude precautionary and improvement work, so t = 0.
Betterment beyond like-for-like copper is excluded under 7.1.9, so t = 0.
A separate contractor and invoice, so one vehicle charge is admitted under 5.2.6(c), capped at EUR 70 net (about 83 gross).
